verified_claims.claim: Evidence vault writes raw EML bytes to local disk repository (evidence_vault/).
verified_claims.notes: Raw EML written to evidence_vault/{sha256}.eml upon ingestion.

verified_claims.claim: Real-time telemetry uses WebSocket broadcast manager (/api/v1/dashboard/live).

verified_claims.claim: RFC 3227 hash chain creates genesis block H0 = SHA256(Raw EML Bytes) and chained event blocks.
verified_claims.notes: create_rfc3227_hash_chain computes genesis block and successive SHA256(H_{n-1} || action || actor || timestamp || details).
